definition: soft wet earth, soil soaked with water
description: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

de.answer: Er stampft sich den Schlamm von den Gummistiefeln.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Se está quitando el barro de las botas a pisotones.
phrases: estar abierta de par en par
